component.name: Velox
component.summary: See, start and stop your containers
Se, starta och stoppa dina containrar

description.p: Velox shows the containers of the computer's Docker Engine or Podman, grouped by Compose project, and starts and stops them. It follows the engine live.
Velox never installs or configures an engine. When none is found, it shows the steps to set up Docker Engine or Podman.
